items: The auditor conducted a ____ examination of the company's expense records.
The company has offices ____ Japan, including locations in Sapporo and Fukuoka.
'Throughout' means in all parts of a place.
The purchasing manager requested a price ____ from each prospective supplier.
A 'quotation' is a formal statement of a proposed price.
The sales team exceeded its monthly ____ by twelve percent.
A 'quota' is a required or expected amount, such as a sales target.
The technician found that the replacement cable was not ____ with the older device.
'Compatible' means able to work properly with another device or system.
The two proposals are ____ in cost, but the second offers a shorter delivery time.
'Comparable' means similar enough to be compared.
The company offers highly ____ salaries to attract experienced engineers.
'Competitive' means as good as or better than what others offer.
The new technician is fully ____ of operating the diagnostic equipment without supervision.
'Capable of' means having the ability to do something.
Only full-time employees are ____ for the annual performance bonus.
'Eligible' means meeting the conditions required to receive or do something.
A conference room is ____ on the third floor from 2:00 to 4:00.
'Available' means free and ready for use.
The weather forecast indicates that flight delays are ____ this evening.
The lobby was unusually ____ during the product launch, with demonstrations and customer interviews taking place continuously.
'Lively' means full of activity and energy.
The finance team will ____ the figures in the report before it is sent to investors.
'Verify' means to check that information is correct or true.
The manager asked the applicant to ____ two professional references on the form.
'Provide' means to give something needed or requested; here the object is references.
All travel-expense claims must be ____ within ten business days.
'Submit' means formally present a document for consideration or approval.
The supplier agreed to ____ replacement filters to all affected customers.
'Supply' means provide goods or materials that are needed.
The store will ____ a 15 percent discount to customers who join the loyalty program.
'Offer' means make something available for acceptance.
Employees should ____ for reimbursement within 30 days of completing business travel.
Please ____ to the meeting invitation by noon on Friday.
'Reply to' means respond to a message or invitation.
The survey results ____ that customers prefer shorter delivery windows.
'Imply' means suggest something without stating it directly.
The chairperson asked everyone to ____ from using mobile phones during the presentation.
'Refrain from' means deliberately avoid doing something.
The new policy is intended to ____ unnecessary spending on business travel.
The company hopes to ____ experienced staff by expanding its professional-development program.
'Retain' means keep people or things rather than lose them.
The regional office will ____ open until 8:00 p.m. during the busy season.
'Remain' means continue to be in a particular state.
The manager asked for a ____ explanation of the unexpected increase in costs.
